mapper.select: SELECT /* getHardDeleteTargetList */ W.WTHD_NUMB , W.USER_NUMB , W.DELT_DATE FROM TH_USWTHD W JOIN TM_USERXM U ON W.USER_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB WHERE W.WTHD_STAT = 'DELETE_PENDING' AND U.USER_STAT = 'DELETE_PENDING' AND W.DELT_DATE <= SYSDATE ORDER BY W.DELT_DATE FETCH FIRST #{maxSize} ROWS ONLY
